name: CTS International Logistics Corporation Limited
summary: CTS International Logistics Corporation Limited operates as a leading freight forwarding enterprise, offering a comprehensive suite of logistical and trade-related supply chain solutions. The company provides its services to clients both within China and internationally. Its diverse offerings include air and sea cargo transportation, multimodal shipping options, specialized project logistics, supply chain trading services, warehousing facilities, and customs clearance assistance. Established in 1984, the firm maintains its principal headquarters in Shanghai, China, and functions as a subsidiary of China Chengtong Holdings Group Ltd.
